title: Settings — Parts without See Financial Data shows Fixed Rules and categories
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Settings — Parts' but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open Settings › Categories.
  3. Click New Category.
  4. Type a name no other category uses.
  5. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Settings › Pricing shows the Fixed Rules tab.
  • It has no Tiers or Matrices tab.
  • The Fixed Rules tab lists the fixed rules as today.

Step 2:

  • The Categories page lists every category.
  • It shows the Category column, with no Pricing Matrix, Default or tier columns.

Step 3:

  • The New Category page shows the name, QuickBooks Products and Services (when connected) and Tax Exempt.
  • It has no Pricing Matrix field and no grid.

Step 4:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 5:

  • The category is created.
  • Signed in as an Admin afterwards, its Pricing Matrix reads General Matrix.
